Static yarixo/yarəxto/yarixe long forms are lexical adjectives; they do not establish a new Part act. paradigm in this entry. Finite feminine yarixo must be distinguished by its clause.

Permitted lookup of mrx confirms overlapping extension forms, including a thumb example despite reflexive gloss. Contracted morax-/mərx- are filed here where yrx III has direct constructional parallels; the division is not a secure dialect diagnostic.
The paired concessive morəx w makre is also cited under kry 1 III; it is added as a collocation, not a second narrative-prolonging sense.
